caption: The drawing features a circular, lace-like object with intricate, repeating cut-out patterns around its perimeter, resembling a doily or decorative paper mat. At the center of this circle is a cluster of pink flowers, each with yellow centers and detailed petals, accompanied by a collection of green leaves with visible veins. The flowers and leaves are rendered in naturalistic colors: pink, yellow, and various shades of green. The lace-patterned circle is pale, primarily off-white or beige, and contains faintly visible handwritten text radiating outward from the center in several lines, partially obscured by the floral arrangement. The entire composition is centered on an otherwise plain, slightly yellowed background. Near the bottom, within the lighter area, the name "S. Philpot" is written.
title: Valentine
